propertyFacts.label: source water hypothesis
propertyFacts.value: Cadmium carboxylates typically bind two water molecules, which the authors expect under these non-rigorously anhydrous conditions. They did not prepare anhydrous cadmium oleate to test the coproduct evolution; no measured hydration stoichiometry is assigned to the reagent.
propertyFacts.scope: Source hypothesis based on expected carboxylate hydration; not a source-refined molecular structure or measured coordination count.

propertyFacts.label: source negative observation
propertyFacts.value: Proposed isomerization product was not detected in the final reaction mixture, although independent thiolcarbonate inactivity and OCS detection support competing paths.

propertyFacts.label: source nucleation hypothesis
propertyFacts.value: Narrower distributions from1a–1g are present early and persist through growth. Weaker Lewis basicity and reduced interference with nucleation are proposed; no unique binding geometry is established.

general_background.title: Thermodynamics and kinetics
general_background.summary: Thermodynamics describes which states are energetically favoured, while kinetics governs how quickly a system can move between them. A change can be favourable yet proceed slowly when an activation barrier or limited transport restricts the pathway.
